title: Unrestrictions and concise secant varieties
summary: We introduce the concise secant varieties, which are, informally speaking, modular partial desingularisations of secant varieties to Segre embeddings. More precisely, they are projective and birational to the abstract secant varieties, yet each of their points corresponds to a concise tensor of appropriate border rank (that is, to a minimal border rank tensor).
